caseNameFull: McCoy v. West Virginia Painter v. Baltimore & Ohio Railroad Co.
attorneys: Arthur McCoy, pro se. Mr. J. Thomas Hoffman for petitioner in No. 355.

opinions.text:
*683On petition for writ of certiorari to the Supreme Court of Appeals of West Virginia; and

On petition for writ of certiorari to the Supreme Court of Pennsylvania.

The petitions for writs of certiorari in these cases are denied for the reason that the applications therefor were not made .within the time provided by law. Section 8 (a), Act of February 13, 1925 (43 Stat. 936, 940).

*684Reported below: No. 68, 7 S. E. 2d 89; No. 355, 339 Pa. 271; 13 A. 2d 396.
